BACKGROUND&EXISTING CONDITIONS

sedimentation has developed within the Dry Creek drainage basin as it meanders throughout the City.

and the creek bed to hydraulically function as designed.Overtime, these structures may even become
completely silted in, with flooding risk becoming imminent.To lessen this risk, and to remain compliant
with federal requirements, urban creeks and infrastructure requires ongoing maintenance which may
include debris removal, sedimentation removal, tree, and vegetation removal; back to a known
floodway cross section based on hydraulic analysis and historical studies and reporting.
